aka: Singapore Economic Development Board Investments Pte Ltd

strategy.thesis: Singapore's consolidated government investment platform, formed by merging EDBI (which anchors growth-stage global tech/life-science companies in Singapore) and SEEDS Capital (which co-invests in early-stage local startups) to deploy public capital, including via the Startup SG Equity co-investment scheme, into deep-tech and biotech ventures.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Predecessor EDBI (est. 1991) invested directly in biotech/life-science companies as the investment arm of the Singapore Economic Development Board; predecessor SEEDS Capital co-invested with private VCs in early-stage Singapore-based biotech/healthtech startups.

summary.en: Government investment entity formed on 1 April 2025 by merging EDBI and SEEDS Capital, deploying Singapore government capital (including the >S$1B Startup SG Equity co-investment pool) into deep-tech and biotech/healthtech companies at both growth and early stages.

strategy.thesis: Singapore government-owned deep-tech platform that helps researchers and technical founders commercialise breakthroughs, investing across four verticals including Health and Biomedical Sciences, and co-managing part of the Startup SG Equity fund.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Runs Deep Tech Talent Central and the Helix Immersion Programme for biotech-sector talent; partnered with SingHealth (2021, three-year deal) to advance healthcare AI adoption.

summary.en: Singapore government-backed deep-tech investor and talent platform (est. 2016) that invests in Health and Biomedical Sciences alongside AI, quantum, robotics and other deep-tech verticals, managing part of the S$200M Startup SG Equity co-investment fund.

aka: Agency for Science, Technology and Research

strategy.thesis: Singapore's national research agency; its commercialisation arm A*ccelerate (rebranded from Accelerate Technologies Pte Ltd/ETPL) translates A*STAR biomedical and life-science R&D into startups, licences and venture-creation partnerships (e.g. with ClavystBio for MedTech venture building, and with Flagship Pioneering on a regional biotech/healthtech hub).

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Operates translational institutes such as SIFBI (Singapore Institute of Food and Biotechnology Innovation) and the A*START Central incubator (capacity for ~25 startups); A*ccelerate is A*STAR's dedicated commercialisation/venture-building arm.

summary.en: Singapore's national science and technology research agency (est. 1991); its A*ccelerate arm commercialises A*STAR biomedical R&D through spin-outs, licensing, incubation (A*START Central) and venture-creation partnerships such as a 2025 MoU with ClavystBio to grow MedTech ventures and a joint up-to-S$100M biotech/healthtech commitment with Flagship Pioneering.

strategy.thesis: Joint venture between government-linked Temasek Life Sciences Laboratory (TLL) and Temasek's Vertex Holdings; incubates and invests (via The Lifesciences Innovation Fund, pre-seed to Series A) in life-science startups spanning human and veterinary health, synthetic biology, nutrition security and healthspan extension.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Provides wet-lab and workspace infrastructure via 'The Hatchery TLA' for early-stage life-science companies.

summary.en: Singapore's first agri-bio-sci-tech incubator (est. 2016), a joint venture of government-linked Temasek Life Sciences Laboratory and Temasek's Vertex Holdings, investing pre-seed through Series A via The Lifesciences Innovation Fund into human/veterinary life-science, synthetic biology and healthspan-extension startups.

strategy.thesis: Life-sciences investor and venture builder set up by Temasek (Singapore's state investment company) to accelerate commercialisation of breakthrough science into health impact, focused on cell and gene therapy, biomarkers/diagnostics and digital health.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Headquartered at Node 1, a 15,000 sq ft collaboration space in Singapore Science Park; co-established 65LAB drug-discovery accelerator with Evotec, Lightstone Ventures, Leaps by Bayer and Polaris Partners.

summary.en: Life-sciences investor and venture builder established by Temasek in 2022; has committed over US$220M to biotech, diagnostics and digital-health companies and early-stage VC funds, and co-founded the 65LAB drug-discovery accelerator with Evotec.

strategy.thesis: Thailand's national public-organization innovation agency (under the Ministry of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation) runs a dedicated health/medtech startup incubation, sandbox and matching program, plus a corporate co-funding investment scheme and a planned baht 1 billion private-equity trust fund with the Stock Exchange of Thailand, contributing to Thailand's #1 ASEAN ranking in MedTech.

summary.en: Thailand's National Innovation Agency (Public Organization), established 2003, runs the MedTech/HealthTech Innovation Incubation and Sandbox program plus a corporate co-funding scheme (seed to pre-Series A, up to THB 10M) and is setting up a THB 1B private-equity trust fund with the Stock Exchange of Thailand; Thailand ranks #1 in ASEAN for MedTech.

aka: Malaysian Research Accelerator for Technology & Innovation

strategy.thesis: MRANTI (Malaysian Research Accelerator for Technology & Innovation), Malaysia's central government agency for turning research into market-ready products, runs a dedicated Healthtech Hub connecting innovators, investors and researchers across the R&D-to-commercialisation pipeline, backed by a 10-acre Integrated Healthcare Cluster at MRANTI Park and the MOSTI-funded Strategic Research Fund (Dana PEMACU) covering healthtech prototyping.

summary.en: Malaysia's government research-commercialisation agency runs a dedicated Healthtech Hub plus the Strategic Research Fund (Dana PEMACU under MOSTI) funding healthtech prototyping and viability testing, with a 10-acre Integrated Healthcare Cluster planned at MRANTI Park.

strategy.thesis: Malaysia's sovereign wealth fund; healthcare is one of its named strategic investment sectors (alongside leisure/tourism, banking, sustainable development), historically built via its controlling stake in Parkway Holdings/IHH Healthcare, Asia's largest private hospital operator, of which it remains a major shareholder (~26%) after divesting a 16% stake to Mitsui in 2018.

summary.en: Malaysia's sovereign wealth fund (est. 1993, ~US$36B AUM as of Dec 2024) lists healthcare as a core strategic sector; it built and remains a major shareholder (~26%) of IHH Healthcare, Asia's largest private hospital group, though it sold a 16% stake to Japan's Mitsui in 2018 for ~US$2.76B.
